title: A thousand fewer paths to root
raw_excerpt: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
summary: OpenAI 披露其自主流水线在 Linux 内核中自动发现、验证并生成补丁修复了 948 个本地提权漏洞，成本约 120 万美元。这是 AI 智能体首次在大规模真实系统代码上完成端到端安全审计与修复闭环，展示了智能体在软件安全领域的实际生产力，也引发对漏洞披露节奏与开源维护者负担的讨论。

title: DeepSeek Plans to Train Its Next-Generation Model on Huawei Ascend Chips
raw_excerpt: DeepSeek plans to use Huawei's Ascend AI chips to pretrain DeepSeek V5. Ascend chips have previously been used primarily for inference rather than pretraining. This will be an important test of whether Chinese AI accelerators can support the full pre-training of a frontier large language model. A successful run could reduce Chinese AI developers' dependence on Nvidia hardware and strengthen Huawei's position as an alternative for advanced AI computing.
summary: 据报道，DeepSeek 计划使用华为昇腾芯片预训练下一代模型 DeepSeek V5。昇腾此前主要用于推理而非预训练，若成功将是国产 AI 加速器支撑前沿大模型全流程训练的重要验证，可能降低中国开发者对英伟达硬件的依赖，并强化华为作为先进 AI 算力替代方案的地位。

title: Data centers lost the midterms
raw_excerpt: Data center developers are poised to face a more restrictive building environment after voters across the country voted in candidates who favor moratoriums and ballot measures that put more obstacles on their expansion, delivering a stinging blow to a central pillar of the AI industry. Of voters polled by NBC News on Election Day, 76 percent said they opposed data centers in their communities. Dozens of local communities voted directly to restrict development through ballot measures . And upset winners like Texas Democratic Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa and Michigan's Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed support moratoriums on development. … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 美国中期选举后，多地选民否决或限制数据中心开发，NBC 民调显示 76% 受访者反对社区内建数据中心，德州、密歇根等关键州选出支持暂停令的候选人。这被视为对 AI 基础设施扩张的重大打击，数据中心开发商将面临更严格的审批环境，可能影响未来算力供给与 AI 产业布局。

title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
raw_excerpt: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.
summary: OpenAI 宣布收购 Pierre Computer Company，以扩展 Codex 在代码构建、理解与审查方面的工具能力。这是 OpenAI 在编程智能体赛道的重要补强，表明其正围绕 Codex 构建更完整的开发者工作流生态，与 GitHub Copilot、Cursor 等竞品争夺 AI 编程入口。

title: Uber only fulfilled 4 rides from AI agents last quarter
raw_excerpt: AI agents won't be stealing Uber's lunch any time soon. Only four rides were arranged by third-party AI agents during the third quarter of 2026, Uber executives disclosed during an earnings call this morning. The volume of Uber Eats orders fulfilled by AI agents was a little higher, with the company recording "around 500" during the week of Halloween, out of a total 320 million Uber rides and Uber Eats deliveries. This is the first time that Uber has disclosed the number of third-party AI agents that have arranged deliveries or rides on its platform. With the rise of AI agents like Meta's Muse or OpenAI's Dots, some experts are predictin … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Uber 在财报电话会上首次披露，2026 年第三季度仅有 4 单行程由第三方 AI 智能体完成，Uber Eats 在万圣节当周约 500 单由 AI 智能体下单，而平台总订单达 3.2 亿。数据表明 AI 智能体对出行与外卖平台的替代威胁目前仍微乎其微，为评估智能体商业化落地提供了罕见的量化参照。

title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
raw_excerpt: It is almost impossible to verify which model produced a specific output. Cryptographic proofs of inference allow model providers to prove that preach suppose was produced which a specific model. These proofs could enable new applications and contribute to a toolkit for verifying compliance with AI pacing requirements. This post details the progress made on a powerful type of cryptographic proof uniquely fit for provable inference called zKSNARK.
summary: Anthropic 发布关于大模型推理可证明性的研究进展，重点介绍 zKSNARK 这类密码学证明如何让模型提供方证明某段输出确由特定模型生成。该能力可用于合规审计与 AI 节奏管控验证，是解决“输出溯源难”问题的关键技术方向，对监管与模型可信部署具有潜在价值。

title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
raw_excerpt: With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier this year. The company expects that portion of its business to grow quickly, forecasting around $650 million in data center revenue during the first quarter of 2027. But it anticipates that will reach $5 billion by the end of 2027 and $15 billion by 2029. Considering the company's total revenue for 2026 was $10.4 billion, … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 高通在 2026 财年 Q4 电话会上表示，智能手机销量同比下滑约 20%，公司将押注 AI 数据中心业务，借助与亚马逊、Meta 的合作，预计 2027 年 Q1 数据中心收入约 6.5 亿美元，2027 年底达 50 亿美元、2029 年达 150 亿美元。这反映移动芯片巨头在 AI 算力浪潮下的战略转型。

title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
raw_excerpt: ChatGPT can now create GIFs using a prompt or a photo uploaded to the AI chatbot. The update, which is rolling out alongside OpenAI's new Images 2.6 model, allows you to adjust the GIF's animation speed, edit individual frames, and share it with others. Before this change, ChatGPT couldn't natively generate GIFs in a single step. An example shared by the company shows how ChatGPT can generate a GIF in response to the prompt, "can you make a gif of a cat dancing?" while also providing you with the option to change the playback speed and view it frame by frame. Along with support for GIF-making, the Images 2.6 update also enables faster imag … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: ChatGPT 随 OpenAI 新图像模型 Images 2.6 上线 GIF 生成能力，用户可通过提示词或上传照片直接生成动画 GIF，并调整播放速度、逐帧编辑与分享。此前 ChatGPT 无法单步原生生成 GIF，此次更新补齐了动态图像创作短板，也显示图像模型正从静态生成向可控动画演进。

title: Siri AI is now open to all developers
raw_excerpt: Developers can now integrate Siri AI into their apps with the iOS 27.3 beta. This update allows apps to leverage Siri's advanced features, like natural language processing and personal context understanding, enhancing user interaction. Siri AI is currently unavailable in the EU and for users under 13. It supports multiple languages, with more to come.
summary: 苹果在 iOS 27.3 测试版中向全体开发者开放 Siri AI 集成能力，应用可调用其自然语言处理与个人上下文理解功能。该能力暂不在欧盟及 13 岁以下用户中提供，支持多语言并将持续扩展。这标志着苹果将 Siri 从系统助手转变为开发者可编程的 AI 平台，对 iOS 生态应用体验影响深远。

title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
raw_excerpt: Computer use CLI for AI agents
summary: Vercel Labs 开源 agent-desktop，一个面向 AI 智能体的计算机使用命令行工具，单日获约 2470 星。它让智能体以 CLI 方式操作桌面环境，降低计算机使用智能体的集成门槛，与近期 GUI 智能体、浏览器智能体热潮相呼应，是开发者构建自动化工作流的新基础组件。
